## 

The Extended Mind: The Power of Thinking Outside the Brain
In this delightful book—clear and provocative and filled with vivid examples and wise advice—Annie Murphy Paul explores the radical idea that our mental processes extend outward from our brains and into our bodies and our physical spaces and the people around us.

## 

The Extended Mind: The Power of Thinking Outside the Brain
This book reveals how we can tap the intelligence that exists beyond our brains—in our bodies, our surroundings, and our relationships.
